Currency Act
(Chapter 69)
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is hereby notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 6th August 2010 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

The Singapore Arms in the centre with the year-date “2010” below it and the word “SINGAPORE” in the 4 official languages around the Singapore Arms. The position of the mintmark is at 5 o’clock of the coin.
The design draws inspiration from the 2010 National Day theme, “Live Our Dreams, Fly Our Flag”, which captures the emotive, inspirational and joyous spirits of Singaporeans in celebrating the nation’s 45th birthday.
At the centre of the coin is a group of Singaporeans rejoicing at the Padang, the venue for this year’s National Day celebrations. Four of them have been shaded in different colours to depict the 4 main ethnic races in Singapore.
Flanking the group of Singaporeans on the left is the logo for this year’s National Day theme while to the right is an artistic perspective of the City Hall.
The denomination is at the upper centre of the coin.
